sentences.text: Tarsomordeo is an extinct genus of reptile belonging to the neosuchian group.
It is a member of the family Paralligatoridae.
The genus was described by Adams in 2019 and contains only one species, Tarsomordeo winkleri.
Fossils of this animal were found in the Early Cretaceous Twin Mountains Formation in Texas.
It lived during the Aptian stage, between 119.57 and 113.2 million years ago.
